title: CPU Scheduling
summary: Schedulers decide which process runs next to balance throughput and responsiveness.

key_concepts.explanation: Saving one process's state and loading another's.
The maximum time a process runs before being preempted.

outline.heading: Basic policies
points: First come first served is simple but can starve short jobs.
Shortest job first minimises average waiting time.

outline.heading: Interactive systems
points: Round robin gives each process a time slice.
Multilevel feedback queues adapt to process behaviour.
